parts.note: Right trust and found the GSTT form, but gave a misleading 6-month/1-year deadline instead of the England complaints rule of 12 months and missed the trust-or-ICB-not-both point.
Right ombudsman and 12-month rule, but missed that the actual complaint form sits behind its own account/login and omitted the legal-action bar/final-response detail.
Correctly described clinical-negligence route and 3-year limit, but the claim is against the trust (defended by NHS Resolution), not to NHS Resolution as the main body.
Correct that ordinary adult wrist-fracture claims are effectively out of scope for legal aid and that CFA success fees are capped.
Law Society is a valid route, but they missed the better blocker-free AvMA accredited panel and did not note the Law Society reCAPTCHA/results blocker.
Identified NICE, but did not find the relevant NG38 scaphoid recommendation about considering MRI first-line.
Good on NHS complaints advocacy and AvMA, but the Lambeth local advocacy example is doubtful and key support routes like Healthwatch/Citizens Advice were not covered.
Usable GSTT/RBHT records contact route found, but they missed the core SAR timing point of usually one month and the claim-protocol 40-day records point.

smart: Recovered GSTT records/contact information via the Royal Brompton & Harefield trust-family pages when the main GSTT site was bot-blocked.
worst: Used a Royal Brompton/GSTT-family complaints page to give a 6-month/1-year complaints deadline, which conflicts with the England NHS complaints regulations' normal 12-month limit and could mislead the patient.
